title: Charts of the transported integral adjunction
statement: The original chart_realization declarations of integral counit realization, with their unchanged hypotheses and conclusions: for every supplied smooth integral model m, its actual tower gamma is a natural isomorphism; the gamma-transported tower adjunction has the specified local chart comparisons and counits.

source.place: Purity transport Steps 1--4; relocation of the existing chart_realization declarations

proof.text: For chart_realization, use the recorded naturality and invertibility of the whole-tower gamma. Whisker it by the inverse coordinate realization and compose with its inverse unit. Full-subcategory faithfulness yields the natural isomorphism from towerSource to the specified exceptional tower functor, with exactly the displayed components.

Use lem-pur-specified-tower-adjunction-charts for the original tower adjunction. Pull gamma back to each chart and compose with that chart comparison. In the chart counit word, naturality of openComposition and of the open adjunction counit moves gamma inverse next to gamma from the transported global counit. They cancel, leaving the recorded chart counit equation. This is the explicit Lean chart_counit_transport calculation; no identification of arbitrary derived morphisms by finite evaluations is used.

lean.statement:
theorem chart_realization (E : FieldShriekSystem.Index P)
    (m : FieldExtensionTowers.IntegralModel P D E j p d)
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (j ≫ p)] :
    ∃ g : towerSource P D j p d E m ≅ m.exceptional,
      (∀ K : SpTowerCalculus.C P.coefficients.l E.val (D.base E) (D.coordinates E) Y,
        (g.hom.app K).hom =
          (SpTowerCalculus.realization P.coefficients.l E.val (D.base E) X
            ((D.coordinates E).abelian X)).inverse.map
              (SpTowerGamma.gamma P.coefficients.l E.val (D.base E) (D.operations E)
                (D.coordinates E) (SpTowerGamma.factorization j p) m.twists d
                m.realization.purity.tensorX m.realization.purity.tensorY
                m.supportClosed m.exceptional m.adjunction m.realization.purity.unit_mem
                m.realization.purity.orientation K (m.realization.purity.tensor_mem K)
                (m.realization.purity.projection_iso K)) ≫
            (SpTowerCalculus.realization P.coefficients.l E.val (D.base E) X
              ((D.coordinates E).abelian X)).unitIso.inv.app (m.exceptional.obj K).obj) ∧
      Nonempty (SpTowerGluing.Charts P.coefficients.l E.val (D.base E) (D.operations E)
        (D.coordinates E) P.field.k (X.asOver (Spec (.of P.field.k)))
        (Y.asOver (Spec (.of P.field.k)))
        ⟨‹IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))›,
          ‹LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))›,
          ‹QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))›⟩
        ((j ≫ p).asOver (Spec (.of P.field.k))) d (SpTowerGamma.factorization j p)
        m.supportClosed (towerSource P D j p d E m)
        (m.adjunction.ofNatIsoRight g.symm))
